QuestInfo.name: [Visitors] Gob's Request
QuestInfo.0: The ancient god #bGob#k, said to have the #bhand of god#k, seems to have something to say to you.
QuestInfo.1: #bGob#k is a researcher and wants to examine your #bAdversary#k body. It's a little nerve-wracking, but it would be good to get a check up...
QuestInfo.2: It seems Gob has something to say after examining your body with the device.
